summary_1line: As the Pandavas depart for exile, Vidura counsels Yudhishthira and Kunti sorrowfully bids farewell to Draupadi and her sons.

image_candidates.scene_text: Draupadi, clothed in a single blood-stained garment with disheveled hair, leaves the palace weeping as grieving women wail in the inner chambers.
Kunti embraces her sons clad in deerskins with their heads bowed in shame while enemies rejoice and friends look on with pity.
Vidura solemnly advises Yudhishthira in the royal court as the Pandavas prepare to depart for their forest exile.
